Triage: `needs-user-decision` + `domain:engine` (hook execution context / ctx helpers land in the runtime evaluation core), type Feature. This is a capability-appetite call — feature-class, manual floor — with a real measurement behind it (second card in the same class from the exemplar app; five inline title reimplementations; hotcrm#1243's id-in-prose defects). Options are the card's three designs: (a) a `ctx` title accessor, (b) hydrate `nameField` into the pre-image, (c) formula fields readable from hook bodies.

[facets-block]
- **实际业务需求**:实测的真实缺陷,不是投机面——demo org 15/31 任务标题是 16 位主键,重复邮箱拒绝答非所问;每个写 hook 的应用都会撞。
- **项目长远合理性**:对象上声明一次的 `nameField`/formula 是唯一权威;逐 hook 手抄拼接必然漂移,样板仓已被迫加两个补偿性检查——那是平台缺口的代偿,不是 CRM 的表达。
- **防 AI 写代码犯错**:最锋利的一轴——agent 写 hook 时 `${record.id}` 是手边唯一在握的值;平台不把正确答案放得比错误答案更近,这类缺陷会按 hook 数量线性再生。
- **创业阶段不扩散需求**:三个设计里 (a) 最小(读侧 helper,不动存储与 formula 通用求值);(c) 是通用能力扩张,单一消费者证据撑不起。
**推荐:(a) 最小 `ctx` 标题访问器**(可解析本记录与 lookup 关联记录的 `nameField`,formula 由服务端求值),(b)/(c) 不做。回「A」/「B」/「C」/「不做」即可。

## Maintainer ruling recorded (atomic four-part write)

Ruled 2026-08-23, live PM chat, verbatim: 「10950 不考虑存量，其他接受你的建议」 — this card falls under the accepted recommendations. **Ruled: design (a)** — a minimal `ctx` title accessor (resolves this record's and lookup-related records' `nameField`; formula evaluated server-side). Designs (b) pre-image hydration and (c) general formula readability are NOT approved. `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in the same stroke (`domain:engine`, Feature).

**Engine seat — held one round, not neglected. Recording the wait on the card so it exists outside a session's memory.**

The maintainer's ruling is on this card and I am not re-opening it: design **(a)**, a minimal `ctx` title accessor; (b) and (c) not approved. This card is `pm:queue` and dispatchable.

**Why it did not go out in the 17:10 batch:** its landing site overlaps a card already in flight.

- **#11230** (dispatched 17:10) follows #11142's precedent, which landed in `packages/metadata-core/src/engine-update-dispatch.ts`, **`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`** and `packages/objectql/src/engine-update-dispatch.ts` (squash `281069522`).
- This card's fix lands on the **runtime** side of hook execution — `packages/objectql/src/hook-wrappers.ts` / `engine.ts` / `packages/core` — since the CLI half (`lower-callables.ts`, `extract-hook-body.ts`) only lowers `handler` to `body.source`; the `ctx` a body receives is assembled at runtime.

`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` sits in both faces. Whether this card actually needs to touch it depends on how the accessor is threaded, and **I have not measured that** — which is exactly why it waits rather than going out on an assumption. This seat asserted a region from prose instead of a diff earlier today (#11201) and was wrong; the correction is on that card.

**Exit condition, so this does not sit indefinitely:** dispatch as soon as either holds — (1) #11230 lands, freeing `engine.ts`; or (2) the accessor's file face is measured and proves disjoint from it. Whichever comes first.

⚠️ One thing worth flagging for whoever implements it, because it shapes the work more than the ruling does: **`display_title` is a formula in four of the five measured cases**, and consequence 1 in the card body is that a hook cannot reach a formula field at all. So a `nameField` accessor that only reads stored columns would answer the *wrong* four of five. The ruling's parenthetical — "formula evaluated server-side" — is load-bearing, not decorative.

Triage's routing is confirmed correct, incidentally: the fix lands in the runtime evaluation core, not in the CLI that does the lowering.

**Claim** — engine seat, session `session_01RfyXxZ2WPjcjhuXpiQQc3y`, branch `claude/issue-11293-hook-ctx-title-accessor`. `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` in one label write, read back.

## ⛔ First: the exit condition I wrote on this card was the WRONG criterion

At 17:52 I recorded: *"dispatch as soon as either holds — (1) #11230 lands, freeing `engine.ts`…"*

**#11230 landed** (PR #11432, squash `5d163792c`) — and `engine.ts` was **not** freed. PR **#11435** (another seat, "privileged driver-level reads join the ambient transaction") opened in the meantime and touches `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` **+58/−6**.

The correct release criterion is the one this seat corrected itself on at 10:07 today and then failed to write into this card: **"is there any open PR still occupying the file"** — never *"did my own PR merge"*. A file does not come out of the pit when your card lands; it comes out when nobody is standing in it. I wrote the wrong test down and then measured rather than trusting it, which is the only reason this was caught.

## What the measurement actually says — dispatching anyway, on region

For another seat's PR the test is the **region**, not the whole file, and regions must be read from diff hunks rather than inferred from a title (the #11201 lesson, also today):

| | region in `engine.ts` |
|---|---|
| **#11435** (open, other seat) | hunks at **5937–5977, 5993–6004, 6062–6073, 6148–6162** — inside `ObjectQL`'s transaction plumbing |
| **this card's likely touch** | `nameField` resolution at **~8093** (`displayField: schema.nameField ?? schema.displayNameField`), plus a comment at 1354 |
| **`hook-wrappers.ts`** | **not touched by #11435 at all** — and this is where a hook body's `ctx` is assembled |

~2000 lines apart, different methods, no shared symbol. Disjoint. The dispatch order names #11435's exact line ranges as off-limits and requires a stop-and-report if the fix turns out to need them.

## The ruling, verbatim

> 「10950 不考虑存量，其他接受你的建议」

⇒ **design (a)**: a minimal `ctx` title accessor resolving this record's and lookup-related records' `nameField`, with formula evaluated server-side. Designs **(b)** pre-image hydration and **(c)** general formula readability are **NOT approved** and are not to be built.

⚠️ Carried into the dispatch order as the thing that shapes the work more than the ruling does: **four of the five measured cases have a `display_title` that is a formula**, and the card's consequence 1 is that a hook body cannot reach a formula field at all. An accessor that only reads stored columns answers the wrong four of five. The ruling's parenthetical — *formula evaluated server-side* — is load-bearing.

Duplicate probe, both legs positive-controlled: no open PR claims this number, and `git ls-remote origin 'refs/heads/*issue-11293*'` is empty while the `*issue-*` pattern returns a live set.
